prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” interior painting company for every St. Louis homeowner — the right one depends on your neighborhood/zip code, the scope of work (single room vs whole house, trim/cabinet work, drywall repair, wallpaper removal), your budget and schedule, and whether you want color consulting or a warranty.

I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions:
- What ZIP code or neighborhood are you in?
- Is this a single room, whole interior, or special work (cabinets, wallpaper removal, repairs)?
- What’s your timeline and approximate budget?
- Do you prefer a local company or a national franchise?

If you want to start looking right away, use these steps and questions to identify a top contractor:

How to find good painters
- Search local reviews: Google, Yelp, Angi, Houzz, Nextdoor and BBB for recent reviews and before/after photos.
- Get at least 3 written estimates (same scope) to compare.
- Check licensing/insurance and ask for references from recent local jobs.
- Look at portfolios or request photos of completed jobs similar to yours.

Questions to ask every painter
- Are you licensed/insured? Can you provide proof?
- Can you give a written estimate and a clear scope of work (prep, number of coats, paint brands, trim/ceiling included)?
- Do you include drywall repair, patching, sanding, primer? If not, what are those costs?
- What paint brands/lines do you use? (Benjamin Moore and Sherwin‑Williams are common quality options.)
- How many coats will you apply and what is your schedule?
- Do you handle color consultation?
- What is your warranty/guarantee for labor and paint?
- Can you provide recent local references and photos of similar jobs?
- What is your payment schedule (deposit, milestones, final payment)?

Red flags
- No written estimate or contract
- Requests for large upfront cash payments
- No proof of insurance or references
- Extremely low bid with vague scope

If you’d like, tell me your ZIP code and scope and I’ll suggest a short list of highly rated painters in your area or draft a message you can send to painters to request bids. I can also help compare estimates if you get them.
